name: Saitou Kimiko
source:
Among the cadets, she was recognized as having the greatest potential and was assigned to Hayakawa’s unit.
She pilots a Precision-type and excels at base assaults.

She is a self-proclaimed and widely acknowledged Walking Tank fanatic and has earned the nickname “Walking Tank Encyclopedia”.
Her boundless energy is her strong point, but because she is far too honest about her own desires, she often runs out of control.
She frequently clashes with her classmate Yuuhi due to their mismatched personalities.

She harbours an extraordinary crush on Kotetsu, the machine piloted by the protagonist.

“In the Major’s unit, even I get a chance to touch Kotetsu!?”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#kimiko]official website[/url]]
